mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id AS tenantId,work_no AS workNo,current_extension AS extension FROM fcc_agent WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND work_no=#{owner} AND status='ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO fcc_agent_presence(agent_id,tenant_id,login_status,work_status,last_state_at) SELECT id,tenant_id,'ONLINE','REST',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM fcc_agent WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND work_no=#{owner} AND status='ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id=p.agent_id SET p.login_status='ONLINE',p.work_status=#{state},p.last_state_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),p.version=p.version+1 WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.work_no=#{owner} AND p.active_call_id IS NULL AND a.status='ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id=p.agent_id SET p.work_status='BUSY',p.active_call_id=#{callId},p.last_state_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),p.version=p.version+1 WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.work_no=#{owner} AND p.login_status='ONLINE' AND p.work_status='READY' AND p.active_call_id IS NULL AND a.status='ENABLED' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id=p.agent_id SET p.work_status='ACW',p.active_call_id=NULL,p.last_state_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),p.version=p.version+1 WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.work_no=#{owner} AND p.active_call_id=#{callId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.work_status AS status,CAST(p.active_call_id AS CHAR) AS callId FROM fcc_agent_presence p JOIN fcc_agent a ON a.id=p.agent_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.work_no=#{owner}

SELECT n.phone_number AS caller,t.gateway_name AS gateway FROM fcc_outbound_number n JOIN fcc_telephony_trunk t ON t.id=n.trunk_id AND t.tenant_id=n.tenant_id WHERE n.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND n.status='AVAILABLE' AND n.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status='ENABLED' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.direction IN ('BOTH','OUTBOUND') ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_extension WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND extension=#{number} AND status='ENABLED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id,tenant_id AS tenantId,ctrl_id AS ctrlId,model_type AS modelType,direction,caller_number AS caller,destination_number AS destination,status,attributes FROM fcc_call_session WHERE id>#{after} AND ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 200

SELECT d.tenant_id AS tenant,d.route_key AS routeKey,v.id AS versionId,v.definition_json AS definition FROM fcc_did_number d LEFT JOIN fcc_flow_definition f ON f.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND f.flow_key=d.route_key LEFT JOIN fcc_flow_definition_version v ON v.flow_definition_id=f.id AND v.publish_status='PUBLISHED' WHERE d.phone_number=#{number} AND d.status='ENABLED' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.version_no DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT a.work_no AS workNo,a.current_extension AS extension FROM fcc_agent a JOIN fcc_agent_presence p ON p.agent_id=a.id AND p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id JOIN fcc_agent_group_member m ON m.agent_id=a.id AND m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id JOIN fcc_agent_group g ON g.id=m.group_id AND g.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND g.group_code=#{group} AND g.status='ENABLED' AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status='ENABLED' AND a.current_extension IS NOT NULL AND p.login_status='ONLINE' AND p.work_status='READY' AND p.active_call_id IS NULL AND a.work_no NOT IN #{owner} ORDER BY p.last_state_at,a.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fcc_callback_task(id,tenant_id,source_call_id,customer_number,did_number,missed_at,missed_reason,status) SELECT #{id},#{tenant},#{callId},#{number},#{did},UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),#{reason},'PENDING' WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fcc_callback_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_call_id=#{callId})
